title: Silent Gear: Shuriken Addon
description: Add a brand-new customizable Shuriken weapon to your Silent Gear experience!
body:
## Silent Gear: Shuriken Addon

Add a brand-new customizable Shuriken weapon to your Silent Gear experience!

This addon introduces a fully compatible Shuriken that integrates seamlessly with the Silent Gear material and trait system. Craft throwing weapons using your favorite materials and create unique combinations tailored to your playstyle.

Features
- 🥷 New Shuriken weapon type for Silent Gear
- ⚒️ Fully customizable using Silent Gear materials
- ✨ Supports material traits and special bonuses
- 🎯 Fast ranged attacks with reusable throwing weapons
- 🔧 Balanced progression that fits naturally into Silent Gear gameplay
- 🤝 Multiplayer-friendly and compatible with modpacks
  
### Requirements:
- Silent Gear
- Minecraft (supported version listed in the files section)


The Shuriken uses Silent Gear's existing material system, allowing compatibility with materials added by other mods that support Silent Gear integration.

Planned Features
Additional Shuriken parts and customization options
Unique traits designed specifically for throwing weapons
Better visual effects and animations
